decisions.reason: As a publicly emphasized flagship stollen with repeated gold-medal recognition, it embodies strong reputational commitment and gives management little reason to reverse course.

Although its niche rye positioning and overlap with the core bread range make rationalization plausible, sunk launch effort and reluctance to concede that the remaining new bread variant has failed still favor keeping it for now.

Even as a secondary seasonal stollen beside the stronger flagship, it stays close to the firm's confectionery core and management can justify one more cycle rather than retreat from the variant too quickly.
